title: E-FRC-0176: the Lorentz force and cyclotron motion on the husk: the fear walk as a charge in a husk plane, its...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0176 in the gauge arena: the Lorentz force and cyclotron motion on the husk: the fear walk as a charge in a husk plane, its Eisenstein weights turned by the link phase on every crossing, deflects sideways in a uniform field, circles at the cyclotron frequency its own symbol predicts, 2 q B per beat for the palindromic walk, and shows Landau levels spaced by it, while the plain alternate walk sits on a saddle.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
